about: Anthony P. Gentile, a founding partner of Godosky & Gentile, New York, New York, has professional legal experience of over five decades. His areas of practice encompass personal injury, professional malpractice law, products liability law, ethics and professional responsibility, and litigation and appeals.

With an extensive track record of representing plaintiffs in personal injury, medical malpractice and product liability cases, Mr. Gentile is known for his prowess in the courtroom. He has secured numerous multimillion-dollar verdicts, including a landmark $65 million verdict in a medical malpractice case in Bronx County, recorded in the Guinness Book of World Records as the highest personal injury recovery at the time. Furthermore, he played a pivotal role as trial counsel in a high-profile commercial case, resulting in a $21 million verdict after a five-week jury trial.

Educated at St. John's University School of Law, graduating in 1971, Mr. Gentile has significantly contributed to legal education through extensive lecturing on personal injury, medical malpractice and product liability. His experience led him to serve as a guest lecturer at Peking University in China on workplace safety.

Mr. Gentile is a member of the International Academy of organizations such as the American Arbitration Association, the American Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, the Columbian Lawyers Association of the City of New York and has served on the board of directors for the Association of Trial Lawyers of the City of New York.

Over his illustrious career spanning several decades, he has garnered a peer-review rating of AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell and is recognized as one of " The Best Lawyers in America." His bar admissions include the State of New York, the U.S. Supreme Court and the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
